reconciled_points: Scope simple exemplar/prototype limitations; no universal compositionality ranking.
Fixed procedures can infer higher-order hypotheses in mutable state; far-family weight-adaptation benefits are an empirical prediction.
Multiple uses do not define every concept or alone prevent collapse/ignoring code.
Retrieval and inference can combine; baseline parity is not evidence of absent abstraction.
Observational abstractions need not require interventions; causal effects need suitable assumptions/data.
remaining_open: Useful scope and budgets of frozen-weight inference for farther task-family shifts.
Whether one mutable state format usefully covers several abstraction types.
Optional explicit-structure comparison for inspectability, without capability preference or adoption.
not_established: General autonomous concept acquisition, persistence and revision.
A unique concept ontology or latent geometry.
Empirical superiority, new architecture adoption, training budget, or research novelty.
